normalization_plan.reason: The _to parameter only exists to designate the transfer recipient inside BasicToken.transfer and carries no independent state, so it collapses into that function node.
The _value parameter is consumed only by the balance arithmetic of BasicToken.transfer, so it is folded into that function node.
The _from parameter is used only to select balances and allowances inside StandardToken.transferFrom.
The _to parameter is local to the StandardToken.transferFrom transfer logic.
The _value parameter is only meaningful within the StandardToken.transferFrom debit and credit operations.
The _spender parameter only identifies the allowance slot written by StandardToken.approve.
The _value parameter is the amount stored by StandardToken.approve and has no standalone semantics.
The _to parameter only designates the recipient of newly minted balance in MintableToken.mint.
The _amount parameter is only used in the supply and balance arithmetic of MintableToken.mint.
The _value parameter is only used to reduce the caller balance and totalSupply in BurnableToken.burn.
The _spender parameter only selects the allowance entry modified by StandardToken.decreaseApproval.
The _subtractedValue parameter is consumed solely by the clamping arithmetic of StandardToken.decreaseApproval.
The oldValue temporary is a short-lived cache of the allowance read inside StandardToken.decreaseApproval and does not persist beyond it.
The newOwner parameter is only used to overwrite the owner state variable inside Ownable.transferOwnership.
